Name: Syanide23's Owls for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With Syanide23's permission, I've converted their BFAV Owls (found [url=http:////www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16146]here[/url]) to work for SDV 1.6 with ContentPatcher. Credit to Syanide23 for the original mod

Owls live in coops and produce owl eggs that can be turned into owl mayonnaise.

Enjoy!
